Content.journalDescription: Travel articles by topic, each language published on its own.
Content.categoriesDescription: Topics group the journal's articles. Name and path per language.
Content.pagesDescription: About, terms, policies and FAQ. Each language is published on its own.
Content.localeEmptyHint: Leave the title empty while this language has no version; a saved version is not removed by emptying it.
Content.slugFixedRoute: This page has a fixed address; the path is used internally only.
Content.excerptHint: Shown in article lists; the start of the article is used when empty.
Content.deletePostBody: The article and all its languages are deleted. A published article must be unpublished first.
Content.deleteCategoryBody: Only a topic without articles can be deleted.

errors.publishNeedsTranslation: At least one language must be published.
errors.publishNeedsCover: A cover image with Vietnamese and English alt text is needed.
errors.contentImageAlt: Images in the content need Vietnamese and English alt text before publishing.
errors.lastTranslation: Unpublish the article before its last published language.
errors.keepLanguage: A saved language is not removed by emptying its title.
errors.published: The article is published: unpublish it before deleting.
errors.in_use: Used by articles; it cannot be deleted.
errors.featureNeedsApproved: Only an approved review can be featured.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Approve, reject and feature reviews. The text is the customer's and cannot be edited; the system marks a review “verified” when it comes from a completed trip.
